description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
When the Snake enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
